direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside beside Kasun's small food three-wheeler, Anudi receives the phone he brings back to her. This small exchange begins their connection.
direction.people: Only their hands and sleeves are visible: Anudi's cream sleeve at frame left, Kasun's faded blue sleeve at frame right. His helpful ease meets her receptive, relaxed hand; her umbrella and handbag remain outside the crop on her left side.

flow.text: Kasun's right hand supports the handset from frame right as Anudi's right hand comes beneath it. Their fingers stay relaxed, with the phone hiding the transfer point.
Anudi secures the phone in her right hand. Kasun releases it without hesitation and withdraws his right hand toward frame right, with no visible hand contact.
Anudi draws the phone slightly toward her body at frame left, her fingers settling loosely around it. Kasun's hand clears the frame, and the completed return holds for the cut.

direction.camera: An 85mm macro insert from the road side at a waist-height oblique angle holds a steady frame on a tripod for four seconds, following no movement as the handset travels between the cream sleeve on the left and faded blue sleeve on the right.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain, distant road wash and faint sleeve movement; no speech and no music.
